text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Tch, an injury like this is nothin', but 
they're makin' me rest up for a while..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My body's getting dull, and my engine's 
gonna rust over at this rate...
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, please.
Then shall we rev up the engine?
Then want to rev up the engine?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My body's getting dull, and my engine's 
gonna rust over at this rate...
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, please.
Then shall we rev up the engine?
Then want to rev up the engine?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I gotta crush my rivals and 
take the top spot.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I ain't gonna be stopped by an injury like 
this.
choice_data_list: You can't ride a broken bike.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...If I stall out halfway down the road, 
it'll look even more uncool than I do 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll properly fix it up before 
trying again...

Taking the lesson to heart, Vodka 
dedicated herself to resting up so she 
could get back in peak condition as soon 
as possible.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's spin it up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't let Scarlet see me looking this 
pathetic either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I gotta tough it out, even knowing it's 
reckless!

Vodka resumed her training after saying 
that, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Ow-ow-ow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Thought I had it in me. 
Honestly, even taking it easy feels 
rough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Talking all that big game, and look how 
pathetic I am. Go ahead and laugh...

Between overexerting herself and feeling 
disheartened, Vodka's injury ended up 
taking even longer to heal...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? Is that okay!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then please, let me do so...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. Let's go for one more dash, 
partner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My engine is something special. It's still 
throbbing hot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just watch. Even where others hesitate and 
drag their feet—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one! I'll blast right past 
'em at full throttle!!

...Vodka pulled off her training 
splendidly!
